judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:37 — P1 (94%): A user merely needs to be an accepted member to create a team-scoped OAuth credential: `userId: req.session?.user.id,`. The `teamId` is parsed directly from the caller-controlled, unsigned OAuth `state` (decodeOAuthState.ts:9), and this branch never calls the admin authorization helper used for user/no-team credentials. A non-admin member can start an OAuth flow with a forged `state.teamId`, complete it against an attacker-controlled provider account, and install that account's credential for the entire team; for example this permits redirecting a team's Stripe integration to the member's Stripe account or replacing its shared calendar/video integration.
